consequence.statement: Existing ClusterExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and an update of status.storedVersions must be run before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration: re-write all ClusterExternalSecret objects so they are stored as v1, then update status.storedVersions to drop v1beta1, before upgrading to a later release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1 (in chart 0.16.0 the CRD no longer marks v1beta1 as storage, true → false), so existing ClusterExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration (re-write all objects) is run and status.storedVersions is updated, which must happen before a later release removes v1beta1.
